page_title: LYO 0-2 MON | Lyon v Monaco 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is awarded a second yellow by Stephanie Frappart and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
90+5' A yellow card for a tackle by Clinton Mata (Lyon). Stephanie Frappart doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+5' Foul! Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Free kick. Monaco will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+3' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is booked for saying more than Stephanie Frappart was willing to tolerate.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' The foul by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Stephanie Frappart.
89' The corner by Lamine Camara (Monaco) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
86' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Wilfried Singo (Monaco) replacing Takumi Minamino.
86' We are about to witness a subsitution. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) for Denis Zakaria.
83' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) will replace Said Benrahma.
81' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
80' 0 - 2 Goal! Kassoum Ouattara provides Lamine Camara (Monaco) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 0:2.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) comes onto the pitch so that Eliesse Ben Seghir can be given a rest.
76' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Said Benrahma (Lyon) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
75' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ismail Jakobs (Monaco). Stephanie Frappart saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Lyon.
75' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

75' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Lucas Perri anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
73' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Abner and he is replaced by Nemanja Matic (Lyon).
73' Malick Fofana goes off the pitch and Mama Balde (Lyon) comes on.
72' Jordan Teze (Monaco) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies just over the crossbar, almost brushing it.
71' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Monaco win a corner.
68' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) picks up an injury.

68' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.

65' 0 - 1 Goal! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes a short pass from Maghnes Akliouche in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
64' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Vanderson will be replaced by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
64' Substitution. Breel Embolo will be replaced by George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
63' Breel Embolo (Monaco) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
63' Lamine Camara (Monaco) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

62' He should have scored! Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.
59' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Breel Embolo (Monaco) sends a wild header high over the bar.
58' Lamine Camara (Monaco) will take the corner.
58' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
57' The game is interrupted as Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is flagged offside.
52' Breel Embolo (Monaco) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
49' Philipp Kohn (Monaco) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
48' Philipp Kohn (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' Lamine Camara (Monaco) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Lyon have a free kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Stephanie Frappart has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Abner (Lyon) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
45+2' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Stephanie Frappart shows the yellow card to Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) for a heavy challenge.
38' The corner from Lamine Camara (Monaco) is intercepted by Lucas Perri.

34' Vanderson (Monaco) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Lucas Perri makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom right corner.
31' OFF THE POST! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
26' A cooling break is underway.
20' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Ernest Nuamah is being substituted because of an injury. Pierre Sage sends Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) on the pitch.
15' Looks like Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
11' A snap shot by Lamine Camara (Monaco) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
3' It's a nice effort by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Lucas Perri. Easy save.
2' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the left post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Monaco will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Stephanie Frappart.
